releases.title: The Celestial Sovereign & Blade Genesis — ASTRAEA's first release
releases.summary: ASTRAEA's first release: five blast doors that open like machines, three locks with lockpicking at hand, five Celestial tools beyond netherite, and the Celestial Blade — drawn, swung, parried and sheathed, with phantom starlight blades, a style rank and a soul forge.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Five blast doors (3×3 and 2×3) that open by hand or by redstone: an iris of six spiralling blades, a hydraulic double gate, a laser-grid hatch, a cryo door that breaks its seal in a burst of steam, and an astrolabe gate whose three rings align before its barrier dissolves into light.

Three locks for doors, trapdoors, fence gates, chests and barrels: a padlock with its own numbered key, a combination lock with a 4-digit PIN and a lock-out that doubles up to 5 minutes, and a biometric lock that lets in only enrolled people and keycards. Only the owner can break a locked block, and redstone and hoppers do not get through.
Lockpicking at hand: the tension wrench in your left hand, the pick in your right. Find the angle by the clicks; force a cylinder that will not turn and the pick bends and snaps.

The Celestial alloy and five tools with 4,500 uses: a pickaxe that mines 1×1, 3×3 or 5×5 (V) straight into your inventory, an axe that fells whole trees and breaks shields, a shovel that levels 5×5, a hoe that tills and harvests 5×5, and a spear that dashes and throws a spear of light.

The Celestial Blade: attack draws it and cuts — four cuts on the ground, three in the air and a diving helm-splitter; use to parry; stand still and it is sheathed, and every foe it struck is cut again, three times. The great strikes split the screen along a line.
Phantom starlight blades: lock on with V or the middle mouse button and eight blades of light follow your cuts; R calls Spiral Drive and Blistering Rain.
A style rank from D to SSS. At SSS, the sovereign awakening: blade tempo ×1.5, movement +30 %, attack speed +50 % and half damage taken.

The Celestial Forge: every defeat pours soul energy into the blade. At a smithing table, mend it, temper it up to 20 times (+2.5 % a level; the twentieth makes a named blade), and unlock three secret arts at 50, 200 and 500 defeats.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer and Java 25. No other mod is needed.
Tested together with Cherry 1.2.0. Installing it together with Alpha is not supported.
/astraeabench measures your frame rate with 32 phantom blades and a space cut every second.
